items.name: Landauer Horizon
items.depicts: Two concentric rings in dark navy and cyan bisected by a full-width horizontal line, with a pale-white glint on the lower-right inner arc.

items.name: Thermal Ray
items.depicts: A single dark-navy pixel centred in an otherwise blank 18x18 frame.

items.name: Boltzmann Tax
items.depicts: A hollow dark-navy circle enclosing a single pale-blue pixel at its centre.

items.name: Erasure Spark
items.depicts: A pale-blue central pixel flanked on all four cardinal sides by single dark-navy pixels.

items.name: Reset Cell
items.depicts: A 12x12 hollow dark-navy square frame enclosing a single pale-blue pixel just off centre.

items.name: Waste Heat
items.depicts: Four staggered vertical dark-navy bars arranged in alternating heights like rising thermal plumes.

items.name: Last Shannon
items.depicts: A 6x6 cyan square centred with a 2x2 pale ice-white core on an 8x8 frame.

items.name: Maxwell Demon
items.depicts: A minimal floating white glyph that appears either as a 2x3 solid bar (1) or a 3x3 hollow ring (0) drifting in empty space.
items.concept: free binary states at the thermodynamic floor
